description: TDD blueprint for the Journey Builder feature: command/ribbon launch shows a welcome screen with Create New / Open Existing choices. Steps define expected behavior before the feature exists.

setup.title: Ensure clean workspace
setup.description: Closes stale Journey Builder leaves and modals from previous runs.

actions.description: Close stale Journey Builder sidebar leaves

steps.title: Open Journey Builder via command
steps.description: Executes the flowti:open-journey-builder command. The Journey Builder sidebar should appear in the right side panel showing a welcome screen with Create New and Open Existing choices.
steps.expectedInput: Plugin enabled, no active Journey Builder instance
steps.expectedOutput: Journey Builder sidebar leaf exists with welcome screen visible

actions.message: Step 1/5: Opening Journey Builder via command

actions.description: Open Journey Builder via command palette
Confirm Journey Builder sidebar leaf via API

actions.label: after-command
actions.description: Journey Builder sidebar with welcome screen

actions.instruction: Verify the Journey Builder sidebar appears on the right side. It should contain a welcome screen with two large action cards: 'Open Existing Journey' and 'Create New Journey'. No canvas should be open.
actions.description: Visual QA of initial Journey Builder state
Close Journey Builder sidebar for step 2

steps.title: Open Journey Builder via ribbon
steps.description: Clicks the Journey Builder ribbon button. Same result as the command: sidebar opens on the right with welcome screen.
steps.expectedOutput: Journey Builder sidebar leaf exists with welcome screen visible

actions.message: Step 2/5: Opening Journey Builder via ribbon

actions.code: (() => { const leaves = app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('flowti-journey-builder'); if (leaves.length === 0) return 'none'; const leaf = leaves[0]; return leaf.getRoot() === app.workspace.rightSplit ? 'right' : 'other'; })()
actions.description: Sidebar is in the right split pane

actions.instruction: Verify the ribbon button has a route icon. The sidebar should appear in the right pane with the same welcome screen as the command-triggered state.

steps.title: Create a new journey via setup form
steps.description: Clicks Create New Journey. The sidebar transitions to a setup form where the user enters journey name, chapter, description, and selects a start event from the event catalog.
steps.expectedInput: Journey Builder sidebar open with welcome screen
steps.expectedOutput: Setup form visible with metadata fields and start event picker

actions.value: A demo journey created by the Journey Builder.

actions.instruction: Verify the setup form shows journey name, chapter, description, and start event fields. The start event input should support autocomplete from the event catalog.

steps.title: Add a step to the journey
steps.description: Clicks Continue to enter the step builder. Adds a step with a title and actions. Sets the end event.
steps.expectedInput: Journey Builder setup form filled with metadata
steps.expectedOutput: Step builder visible with one step added and end event set

actions.description: Click Continue to enter step builder

actions.instruction: Verify a step card appeared in the sidebar with the step title. The step should show an editable actions list. An end event field should be visible at the bottom of the step builder.

steps.title: Export journey JSON
steps.description: Clicks the Export button. A JSON file and test file should be created with the correct JourneyDefinition structure.
steps.expectedInput: Journey Builder with metadata, start event, one step, and end event
steps.expectedOutput: Journey JSON file and test file created with valid structure

actions.code: (() => { const file = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('03 - Resources/Test Data/journeys/E2E Demo Journey.journey.json'); return file ? 'exists' : 'not-found'; })()
actions.description: Journey JSON file exists in vault

actions.code: (async () => { const file = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('03 - Resources/Test Data/journeys/E2E Demo Journey.journey.json'); if (!file) return 'not-found'; const content = await app.vault.read(file); const def = JSON.parse(content); return JSON.stringify({ hasJourney: !!def.journey, hasChapter: typeof def.chapter === 'number', hasSteps: Array.isArray(def.steps) && def.steps.length > 0 }); })()
actions.description: Exported JSON has valid JourneyDefinition structure

actions.instruction: Open the exported JSON file and verify it matches the JourneyDefinition schema: journey name, chapter number, description, start event as first emit action, end event as last assert action, and at least one step with id, title, and actions.

teardown.title: Close builder and clean up
teardown.description: Closes the Journey Builder sidebar, modals, and deletes test artifacts.
